title: Harbor Records Recovery
briefing: Carry the port records from the storehouse to the waiting ship before the tide turns.
history: A fictional harbor logistics exercise. Merchant records documented cargo and agreements; map dimensions and schedules are scenario data.

locations.name: Old quay
locations.description: Start with an empty handcart at 3 m/s.

locations.name: Records store
locations.description: Collect 20 kg of records. Loaded speed is 2 m/s.

locations.name: Waiting ship
locations.description: Reach the ship before the 160-second tide deadline.

required.title: Available capacity
required.prompt: The handcart supports 50 kg. Records weigh 20 kg. How much capacity remains?

crisis.title: A slippery gangway
crisis.description: Rain reduces handcart capacity by 20%. Calculate the new limit and choose a safe response.

challenge.title: Reduced capacity
challenge.prompt: 50 kg capacity decreases by 20%. What is the new capacity?

choices.label: Proceed carefully · 40 kg capacity · half speed
Wait for shelter · full speed · 20 s delay
